name: wheelhouse
description: Wheelhouse's pane and status bar for VS Code: the cards that need you, with buttons only you can press.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Wheelhouse signs your clicks with this computer's key, so it runs only in a folder you trust.

languageModelTools.name: wheelhouse_record
languageModelTools.displayName: Record a click on a Wheelhouse card
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Records that the director chose a button on a plain question card on Wheelhouse's board, as a click in the chat (a non-binding note). It refuses any card that could bind something (a merge, a guardrail change, a ruling's confirmation, or a step confirmed outside the chat): those are answered only with the buttons in the Wheelhouse pane. Needs the card's id and its full 64-character hash from the board. Use it only when the director has just told you which button they chose.

hash.description: The card's full sha256 hash (64 characters), as the board shows it.

text.description: The director's own words, only for Suggest a change.

languageModelTools.name: wheelhouse_board
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the cards on Wheelhouse's board: what each is, its id and hash, and its buttons. It changes nothing.
